summary: This bill requires the Secretary of the Treasury to submit detailed reports to Congress on the national debt, including proposals to reduce it, before the debt limit can be increased or when it is near its limit, and to provide certain financial data to congressional committees upon request.

scores.thoughts: This bill is primarily focused on increasing accountability and transparency regarding the national debt. It mandates reports from the Treasury Secretary on debt levels, drivers, and proposals to reduce its growth, explicitly aiming to promote fiscal responsibility. This directly aligns with prioritizing debt reduction through increased oversight and planning.

The bill's core purpose is to impose new reporting and accountability requirements on the Treasury regarding the public debt, including mandatory presidential proposals to reduce or slow debt growth in the short, medium, and long term, debt-to-GDP projections, and progress reports after any debt-limit increase. This directly promotes fiscal restraint and deficit reduction as the central theme of the legislation.
